subject: Human Evolution
title: AI and the Future of Language
description: A fast breakdown of AI and the Future of Language for builders.

hook.text: Large language models generate fluent text without understanding a single word. Is that language?

buildup.text: For millions of years, language required a social brain, a body, and shared experience with others.

discovery.text: AI strips language down to statistical patterns—and still produces surprisingly coherent output.

twist.text: This challenges us: if pattern-matching mimics meaning, what exactly makes human language special?

climax.text: The answer may be embodiment. We don't just process words—we feel them, live them, need them to survive.

punchline.text: Machines string words. Humans live them.

quiz.question: What might make human language different from AI language?
options: Embodied experience and social meaning behind words
